checks: Guest pages and protected drawer links require sign-in
Drawer defaults open and persists both states; breadcrumbs and menu page sizes match navigation
A lost checkout response can be retried without creating a duplicate order
Registration saves an optional address; checkout prefills contact details, accepts edits and clears stale map pins
Expired access token refreshes through the real HttpOnly browser cookie
Customer registration, red field errors, cart continuity, checkout, location pin and owned history
Failed server sign-out clears local access, displays a warning and retries revocation
Admin Users search, profile editing and courier promotion revoke the previous session
Couriers request delivery, cannot self-assign, and cannot open admin pages
Admin approval, assigned-only history, sequential courier status changes, real GPS sharing and required cancellation reason
Responsive drawers, focus containment, reduced motion, dark menu, image loading and browser runtime
Production direct URLs, API/asset 404s, strict CSP and compressed immutable assets
Vite WebSocket proxy gives one actionable outage warning and recovers after an API restart
method: Compiled production app, isolated synthetic MongoDB, browser-driven forms and navigation, real API/Socket.IO, and an isolated Vite server restart test. No development database or existing dev server is used.
